1：在每个相关工作段落中陈述了论文的贡献和/或其在文献中的地位。

段落2：提到“Our contribution builds directly on this line of work but goes further: we derive a compact VLB expression... yielding faster convergence and substantially higher likelihoods than the methods of [4] and [6].” -> 贡献和定位。
段落3：提到“In contrast, our approach treats the diffusion schedule as a learnable component... This results in a diffusion model that not only samples efficiently but also achieves superior likelihoods, demonstrating that schedule learning is essential...” -> 贡献和定位。
段落4：提到“By contrast, our analysis produces an intuitive, closed‑form VLB... Empirically, we benchmark against the methods of [9]–[11] and show that our schedule‑learning strategy consistently yields lower negative log‑likelihoods...” -> 贡献和定位。
段落5：提到“Our method departs from this paradigm by directly parameterizing the marginal mean and variance... Consequently, our work establishes a new benchmark for diffusion‑based density estimation and positions learned diffusion schedules as a key design principle...” -> 贡献和定位。

因此，文本完全符合评分标准中的1分要求。

推理理由B：指出有多个段落，每段都涉及贡献和/或定位。详细列举了每段的内容，并得出结论：每段清楚地陈述了论文的贡献及其在文献中的地位。预测分数为1。推理理由B完全支持预测分数1。

两者都准确描述了文本内容，并且与评分标准1的要求一致。因此，A和B的推理理由都支持其预测分数。
